function: Learns UE offloading transmit power jointly with service association, task partition, computing allocation and UAV trajectory to minimize long-term average delay (p. 8-9).
system: 25 single-antenna UEs, 5 multi-antenna UAVs at 100 m, 1000 m x 1000 m area, G2A and A2A links; no RIS; band not stated (p. 4, 12).
method: Reinforcement learning: hybrid soft actor-critic with Gumbel-Softmax discrete and Gaussian continuous actions, central controller agent, Lyapunov energy queues; 800 training episodes (p. 7-13).
data_channel: Custom simulation: G2A Rician fading (10-20 dB factor) and A2A log-distance path loss with shadowing; random UE locations and task sizes (p. 5-6, 12).
test_conditions: Single simulated environment, 800 training episodes; results vs. training episodes, M (Fig. 7) and N (Fig. 9); network input sizes depend on N and M (p. 11-15).
baselines: Learned only: W/O DT and W/O Lyapunov hybrid SAC variants, UBG with SAC [22], DDPG [37], DDQN [21]; no non-learned baseline (p. 12).
metrics: Long-term average UE delay, average UAV energy consumption, average reward and convergence over training episodes, UAV trajectories (p. 13-15).
complexity: Order of training complexity in N, M and hidden-layer sizes, O(2NM^2(h1Q + h1P) + h1Q h2Q + h1P h2P + h2P); no runtime (p. 12).
q1_support: p. 5: "G2A channels are dominated by the Rician fading channels [28]"; A2A uses a "classical log-distance path loss model [31]" with shadowing: a custom simulator, with no 3GPP, COST 2100, DeepMIMO, or measured data.
q2_support: p. 13: "train the proposed algorithm (and benchmarks) by 800 episodes"; M and N are swept in Figs. 7-9, but the networks are sized by N and M (p. 11), and no test of a trained model on unseen conditions is stated.
q3_support: p. 12: "Under the same hybrid SAC algorithm, this case relies solely on the central controller"; W/O DT and W/O Lyapunov are ablations, UBG integrates SAC, DDPG and DDQN are learned: no non-learned baseline is compared.
q4_support: p. 12: "the total computational complexity of training" these networks is expressed as O(2NM^2 x (h1Q + h1P) + h1Q x h2Q + h1P x h2P + h2P), the order of the cost of the proposed method.
q5_support: p. 12: "M = 5 UAVs and N = 25 UEs are randomly located"; the data are simulated and no code or data link appears anywhere in the 17 pages.
notes: Borderline: mostly edge computing (association, partition, computing allocation, trajectory), but the agent also learns the UE transmit power of the G2A link (p. 8-9, Table I), so it is kept under the rule that a physical-layer decision learned jointly with above-PHY ones passes above_phy; area 6 (power control for aerial links). The reviewer should confirm. The UBG benchmark pairs a bipartite-graph association with SAC (p. 12), so it is not counted as non-learned. Fig. 6 uses N = 10, M = 2, unlike N = 25, M = 5 in Sec. V-A (p. 12, 14), consistent with separate training per size. Table III gives no carrier frequency (p. 12).
